subject: tr-def
title: TR.DEF.------CULT.SOLD.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-37, where Braxton defines a spectacle-diversion sequence as determined by '(1) the time cycle of a given situation, (2) the vibrational cycle (and how this consideration is manifested in a given physical universe situation), (3) the social reality cycle of a given culture, and finally (4) the political particulars of a given culture.' (C)TR-DEF (trans-definition) is crossed with CULT-SOLD (culture solidification): the question is what trans-definition does to culture solidification when spectacle-diversion is operative. Above the main line, C-CONT (composite continuance) branches from the subject and leads to LK-IMP (linkage implications) and on to MT-INFO (multi-information). Below it, CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) branches from the subject and leads to IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics), then to INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), POST (postulation), and RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits).
